Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, the Lord of the Noble Throne
All praise is for Allah, the Lord of all the worlds
O Allah, I ask You for all that which incurs Your mercy
And the determination for Your forgiveness
And the benefit from every righteousness

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَدَعْ لِيْ ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ
Translation: O Allah, leave not any sin of mine unforgiven

Arabic text: وَ لَا حَاجَةً هِيَ لَكَ رِضًا وَ لِيَ فِيهَا صَلاحٌ إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا
Translation: Nor any need which pleases You and is good for me unfulfilled
O Most Merciful of those who show mercy
Accept our prayer, O Lord of all the worlds
